items.context: An email from the IT department to all staff

items.prompt: The new security system has been up and running ___ the beginning of the month.

explanation.en: Since is used with a starting point in time. For is used with a length of time, such as for three weeks.
explanation.es: «Desde» + punto de inicio es «since»; «for» va con duración.

items.prompt: As a result, all staff are ___ to change their passwords by Friday.

explanation.en: The passive be required to + infinitive is correct. Demanded and insisted cannot be followed by this structure.

items.prompt: Passwords must be at least twelve characters long; ___, the system will reject them.

explanation.en: Otherwise means if you do not do that. Moreover adds information and therefore gives a result.

items.prompt: Employees are not allowed ___ unapproved apps on company devices.

explanation.en: Be allowed is followed by to + infinitive.

items.prompt: If you ___ your laptop on public transport, report it to us immediately.

explanation.en: With an imperative in the main clause the if-clause takes the present simple.
explanation.es: Tras «if» no se usa «will» ni «would»: presente simple.
